name: Moon Dust
requirements: Side-view strip texture that repeats along a road ribbon: rows from the top = top surface (about 2 px), slab body (about 4 px), shadow skirt (about 20 px). Pixel art, point filtered, tileable horizontally, palette-limited to match the VISTA backgrounds. Also needs a physics hint (grip low/normal/high).
notes: Procedural forge, quality 3.0/5. Physics hint: grip normal-low, bounce 0.0 (low gravity mode suggested). Import settings still to set in inspector.
licence: own work (procedural; palette sampled from CC0 tundra/cairn greys)

history.note: No CC0 pixel moon ground found. Forge by grey recolour of blaze sand/snow slab with crater dots.
